name: Peter
source:
"You’ve no idea how happy that makes me!"

Peter the Peanut’s past drove him to become the life-saving paramedic he is today. Despite being shy, and hiding behind his bangs, his determination and dedication shines through. By pure observation, he can discover other’s weaknesses/strengths and rally allies to his side. He’s over the moon when he discovers that Hazel loves animals as much as him. Will Hazel give this shy sweetheart a chance?

[From official profile]
